claim: Memory untouched in a recording is not proven free, so scan every wave, room and stage and prefer write-first bytes before choosing a tail site.

evidence.text: The survey's free RAM (0xB536-, 0xD2EE-) holds graphics untouched by the recording, not free.
0x9000-0x901F looked free in wave 1 and took writes in other waves.
5B10 looked untouched over 2,500 frames and was first read later; write-first variables confirmed over longer recordings are the place.
First choice 0x9400 was stage 4 graphics; the stage-4 recording's scan caught it.
Art mapped in slot 2 hid a room map below 0x6000; read the game's data before mapping over it.
Printer buffer used: the game's bit-reverse table, read before written.
